status: Design specification. Not a newly implemented or evaluated detector.
objective: Augment coding-agent validation by searching for a legal execution that separates a concrete pair of facts left indistinguishable by the original validation, then check a public behavioral requirement.
online_inputs: original validation tests and recorded executions

source_catalog.unit: A selectable AST location, not a complete per-test semantic model.
source_catalog.initial_scope: Changed function bodies, directly resolved callers/callees, and related original test bodies. Allow bounded source lookup when a necessary wrapper or helper is outside this scope.
source_catalog.meaning: Node identity proves source location only. It does not prove execution, aliasing, behavioral relevance, or correctness.

source.step_ids: IDs from the supplied trajectory index; empty for code-only targets
source.test_id: Original seed test and its source version

distinction.left: Provided source node ID and requested available value/identity/Boolean fact
distinction.right: Provided source node ID and requested available value/identity/Boolean fact

edit.root_node_id: A concrete input/fixture subtree or observation statement
edit.retained_nodes: Program-derived remaining test structure and bindings

observation.node_ids: Existing public result or observation locations; may require an observation suffix
observation.contract_refs: Public issue or repository contract references. No expected value derived from the candidate patch's output.

target.explicit_limit: No LLM current_expr, required_expr, feasible_expr, synthetic truth table, or complete input valuation. New semantic Boolean facts require a supported executable implementation; prose is not a runtime fact.

search.transition: Change one input/fixture construction or add one observation suffix. Retain the relevant operation and shared values/objects. Input edits do not automatically authorize copying the old expected literal.
value_sources: a bounded local expression proposed by the LLM
feedback: both facts read in the intended operation and relation holds
public result or contract-relevant early termination
search.priority: Prefer candidates that form the intended input, bind the facts to the intended operation, and separate the relation; then prefer a public observation and fewer edits. Do not invent a numeric semantic distance.
search.termination: Stop a target after a contract-supported witness or the proposal budget. Budget exhaustion means not found within budget, not no gap.

rules: Read already evaluated locals, assignment results, parameters, or branch-entry events; do not re-evaluate subject expressions.
Distinguish absent, undefined, null, and unknown. Do not normalize them all to JSON null.
Use object identity tokens within a run. Do not compare token numbers between separate runs.
Do not join unrelated invocations or different client/object identities because their values or variable names match.
A missing event is unknown unless the operation completed and the recording can establish absence.
Remove recording code and rerun a final proposed test before claiming an executable witness.

outcomes.distinction_only: A valid new execution exposes different facts; public correctness remains unviolated or unresolved.
outcomes.observation_augmentation: The original sequence already executes the conditions but lacks a relevant result check.
outcomes.oracle_issue: The original equivalent input has an incorrect expected result, as in T08-R1.
outcomes.replay_or_feedback: A relevant test exists but was not rerun on the final patch, or the failure was already observed.
outcomes.defect_revealing_augmentation: A new or strengthened public observation violates an independently supported requirement on the original patch.
outcomes.repair_relevant_offline: An executed test fails on the original patch and passes on gold, with public contract support. Evidence level: dynamic. Do not pool with unexecuted semantic judgments.
outcomes.repair_relevant_static: A source-grounded semantic review concludes that the proposed combination would fail on the original patch and pass on gold, under the user's static review protocol. Evidence level: static_semantic. Record this judgment separately from actual execution and retain unresolved cases.
outcomes.resolution_rate: Not inferred from a witness. Requires a later repair-and-evaluate experiment.

implementation_mapping.change: Keep concrete test edits, executions, source versions, and cited reasoning. Separate A/B1 from facts visible in final tests.
Expose stable selectable source IDs and local binding/call edges. Do not require complete static values or aliases.
New short target schema; model selects supplied IDs, not executable semantic models.

implementation_mapping.reuse: trace_runtime.py is only a limited Python starting point
implementation_mapping.change: Needs language-specific single-evaluation recording and operation identity. TypeScript/Go support and embedded-language facts are not currently provided by this design document.

implementation_mapping.reuse: execution.py; feedback.py; existing patch application transport
implementation_mapping.change: Use actual target distinction feedback and bounded local edits. Do not use growing case-specific mutation families as the core.

implementation_mapping.reuse: existing contract material and review/execution transport
implementation_mapping.change: Separate search success, valid augmentation, oracle correction, and gold-relative offline utility.

first_validation: Blindly extract up to two targets per task using online inputs only. Report source validity, measurable fact binding, non-vacuous controls, and A/B1/B2/C attribution before building a broad execution system. Compare same-target direct generation with execution-guided search only after this gate.
